source.title: Section subdivisions of the Robertson 1922 harmony
source.description: Split points (verse boundaries) that subdivide 35 of Robertson's 184 sections into lettered subsections. 34 follow Robert L. Thomas & Stanley N. Gundry's NIV/NASB Harmony of the Gospels numbering (their editorial split of Robertson's longer sections, e.g. their §8 -> §8a/§8b/§8c); one (§44a/§44b) is SonLife's own teaching-tradition split, not part of Thomas & Gundry's numbering (see the per-entry subsection_source field).
source.derivation: Verse boundaries only — no Thomas & Gundry or SonLife text is reproduced here. Cross-verified against two independently sourced transcriptions of the Thomas & Gundry split points and against content/harmony/robertson-1922-outline.json, which remains the untouched canonical Robertson dataset; this file is an additive overlay on it, not a replacement.
source.rights_note: Independently choosing (or verifying) subdivision split points needs no rights clearance — see docs/content-rights.md §3 point 4. Subsection titles are original phrasing from a SonLife ministry resource, used under the project's existing SonLife relationship (docs/content-rights.md §1).
